_banner: FINALIZED at freeze, 2026-08-26. The orchestrator appends `_csv_row` VERBATIM to governance/BAND_REGISTRY.csv in the stamping commit (the r1 / rung2 / carcasum_arb / h2h_22016 / d2r3 / d2r4 precedent: claim the real row at freeze-commit time rather than deferring to launch, because a deferred claim is exactly how bands 143000000000 and 144000000000 got double-claimed by concurrent prep sessions). ⚠️ THE ROW BEING APPENDED DOES NOT ARM THE LAUNCHER: run_cells.sh additionally requires a BAND_CLAIMED sentinel file in this directory, which is DELIBERATELY NOT created at freeze. That file is the owner/orchestrator interlock and is dropped only after DESIGN.md §0's sign-off table reads GIVEN or DONE on all five lines -- and line (a), the FUNDING, is NOT GIVEN as of this freeze.
crn: DECK-LEVEL ONLY, WITHIN EACH CELL. Each cell plays its own decks at BOTH seatings and its primary statistic is its OWN internal deck-paired margin D(d) = (diff(a_seat=0) + diff(a_seat=1))/2. ⚠️ THE FOUR CELLS DO NOT SHARE DECKS -- deliberately, see `disjoint_ranges_rationale`.

cell_allocation.knobs: invasion_beta/alpha/gamma/delta_farm all EXPLICITLY 0.0; both INERT shape-B knobs at defaults
cell_allocation.note: The GAME-LEVEL weight-0 identity gate. Its candidate leaf hash EQUALS the champion's because an explicit-zero invasion config IS the champion leaf bit-for-bit (SHAPES.md §6: the hash names the leaf FUNCTION, not the JSON text), so this cell runs under the harness's STRICT hash assertion -- NO --allow-leaf-hash-drift. ⛔ A FAILED IDENT VOIDS ALL FOUR CELLS (READ_RULE.md §3.4).
Shape A -- contested-value transfer, cities+roads+farms. Runs WITH --allow-leaf-hash-drift (a nonzero weight moves the hash by design).

Shape B -- stub-claim merge-potential bonus, offence-only. ⚠️ The cap is forwarded to rust ONLY because invasion_alpha != 0 (rust_agent.py:181-185 nests the two INERT knobs under a nonzero alpha); G-CAPFWD asserts the biconditional. Also the SMOKE cell -- the most plumbing to break.

Shape D -- shape A restricted to FIELDS. ⚠️ COLLINEAR WITH A by construction (T_A == cities+roads part + T_D exactly, SHAPES.md §4). A_MID and D_MID are two points on ONE 2-D surface read on the (beta, beta+delta_farm) basis = (0.12,0.12) and (0.00,0.12). NOT two independent shapes.

shape_c_deferred: Shape C (invasion_gamma) is NOT RUN in round 1 and spends no seeds. SHAPES.md §3: C is DEFENCE-ONLY and its H2H-vs-champion null is EXPECTED BY DESIGN (the champion does not invade), so a C cell here would purchase a guaranteed-uninformative null at ~18 core-h. Its round-2 weight is nonetheless DERIVED AND NAMED at freeze (gamma mid 0.23; bracket 0.08 / 0.23 / 0.69) so round 2 inherits a derivation rather than re-picking one. This is the pair's ONE deviation from the prereg skeleton's '5 cells', and it is the skeleton's own §3 rule applied.
disjoint_ranges_rationale: DELIBERATE, and it costs the primary read NOTHING. track_d2r4_prep shared one deck set across its two cells because its primary statistic was the DIFFERENCE BETWEEN CELLS, which requires CRN. This pair's primary statistic is each cell's OWN internal deck-paired margin -- fully CRN'd within the cell (same deck, both seatings) and needing nothing from the other cells. What disjointness DOES cost: shape-vs-shape ranking becomes a deck-unmatched contrast, so READ_RULE.md §1 and §5 FORBID any branch from taking 'A read higher than B' as an input. Each cell is adjudicated against ZERO, on its own decks, never against a sibling.

smoke_range_disjoint.status: THROWAWAY. Discarded, never pooled, never claimed as a band, never adjudicated as a result. DESIGN.md §9.
smoke_range_disjoint.note: Deliberately far above the cell ranges so no arithmetic slip can reach them. The leg's PURPOSE is structural: it produces the REAL EMITTED MANIFEST the pair's adjudicator is validated against, and it ENDS by running analyze_screen.py --smoke-mode against that archive, requiring failures confined to the pinned allowed set (READ_RULE.md §3.5). A gate that cannot read what the harness emits is a LAUNCH BLOCKER, not a readout surprise.

no_topup_reserved: DELIBERATE. READ_RULE.md §5 carries NO top-up branch. A top-up exists to rescue a design whose inconclusive region is a failure state; here a bounded null IS a licensed and expected outcome of a SCREEN (READ_RULE.md §4 SCREEN-NULL-family-parks), and the bound is the deliverable. Resolving a small true effect is a fresh funding decision and a fresh band, not a top-up.

all_branches_sweep.procedure_of_record: measurement/carcasum_arb_challenge_prep/DESIGN.md §4.1, as extended by measurement/h2h_22016_prep/BAND_CLAIM.json and re-run by measurement/track_d2r3_prep/ and measurement/track_d2r4_prep/. For EVERY ref in refs/heads AND refs/remotes: read that ref's own governance/BAND_REGISTRY.csv AND every measurement/**/BAND_CLAIM*.json it carries; take the lowest integer clear of everything found anywhere across ALL refs, not just the checked-out branch's registry high-water mark.
all_branches_sweep.why_the_main_tree_check_is_insufficient: Bands 143000000000 and 144000000000 were each double-claimed on 2026-08-24 by concurrent prep sessions whose registry checks were scoped to the checked-out branch and therefore could not see an unmerged sibling freeze branch's own row. Both collisions were caught pre-launch at zero games and self-amended.
all_branches_sweep.scope_realized: 139 refs scanned (122 refs/heads + 17 refs/remotes); 641 BAND_REGISTRY.csv / BAND_CLAIM*.json blobs read across them. Larger than track_d2r4_prep's stamped '135 refs / 563 files' because several worktree-agent-* branches (concurrent-session worktrees, including this build's) have been created since that stamp -- expected, not a discrepancy.
all_branches_sweep.verification_method: Two independent passes: (i) a raw-mention sweep over every blob, and (ii) a direct row-start grep for `146000000000,` and for `15[1-5]000000000,` in every one of the 139 refs' registries. Zero hits both ways for 151000000000.

It is SKIPPED anyway, on the identical reasoning carcasum_arb_challenge_prep, h2h_22016_prep, track_d2r3_prep and track_d2r4_prep all used: d1-rebase-freeze has spent a committed paragraph earmarking it for that track's own n=800 extension and asked that nothing run there without a fresh funding decision. Taking it for an unrelated cell would manufacture the exact collision the corrected procedure exists to prevent, the moment that extension is funded.
all_branches_sweep.why_151_not_150: 150000000000 is SPENT: track_d2r4_prep ran it clean to completion and adjudicated D2-BOUNDED-NULL with decision_influenced=yes. It is retired from confirmatory use under the standing band rule. A band that has influenced a decision can never again be a clean draw.
all_branches_sweep.reverify_before_append: MANDATORY. The sweep is RE-RUN immediately before the CSV append, in the stamping commit, and the append is ABORTED if 151000000000 has appeared anywhere in the interim.

cross_band_discipline: Per CL-068, band identity is LOAD-BEARING. NEVER pool this pair's numbers with any other band, and NEVER quote a pooled estimate. Cross-band contrasts on this instrument are over-dispersed 1.8-2.2x. ⚠️ The contrasts THIS pair reads are within-band AND deck-paired AND single-instrument -- the robust class CLAUDE.md exempts from the humility discount. 151000000000 RETIRES from confirmatory use once it has influenced any decision, including a SCREEN-NULL family-park decision.
release_if_never_launched: If no cell is ever launched, 151000000000 is RELEASED under the BAND_REGISTRY.csv RELEASE-IF-NEVER-LAUNCHED clause -- a band is spent only once REAL RECORDS exist on it. ⚠️ THE CLAUSE DOES NOT SURVIVE A VOID: if the round runs and adjudicates U-UNREADABLE -- including on a G-IDENT failure after only the 400-game IDENT cell -- real records exist and the band is SPENT and RETIRED, exactly as bands 141e9, 144e9 and 149e9 were retired by prior voids. Attempt 3 of D2 is the worked example: it aborted at 80 of 800 games -- a fifth of one cell -- and its band was spent all the same.
